tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current weather and 3-day forecast for any city worldwide (city name in any language, or coordinates).

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Live currency exchange rate: one pair with conversion, or a major-currency table for a base currency.

tools.name: stock_quote
tools.description: Live-ish stock quote for China A-shares, Hong Kong and US markets: price, change %, open/high/low. Not investment advice.

tools.name: china_reachability
tools.description: Test whether a URL is reachable from a real mainland-China network: HTTP status, latency, DNS answers from Chinese resolvers. Unique vantage point for checking if your site is blocked or slow in China.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Check if a domain is registered via official RDAP: availability, registrar, created/expiry dates, nameservers.

tools.name: ssl_check
tools.description: Inspect the TLS certificate of a domain: issuer, validity window, days until expiry, trust status, SANs.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Live air quality for any city: US/European AQI, PM2.5, PM10, ozone.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: IP address geolocation and ISP: country, region, city, ISP, timezone.
